senses.gloss:
I. 2 Ā. (पृक्ते, पृक्ण) To come in contact with. --II. 7 P. (पृणक्ति, पृक्त) 
__1 To bring into contact with, join, unite; एवं वदन् दाशरथिरपृणग्धनुषा शरम् [[Bk. 6. 39.]] 
__2 To mix, mingle. 
__3 To be in contact with, touch. 
__4 To satisfy, fill, satiate. 
__5 To augment, increase, 
__6 Ved. To give or grant bountifully. --III. 1 P., 10 U. (पर्चति, पर्चयति-ते) 
__1 To touch, come in contact with. 
__2 To hinder, oppose.
[प्रच्छ्-ण्वुल् संप्रसारणम्] An inquirer, an investigator; पृच्छकेन सदा भाव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता [[Pt. 5. 93]]; [[Y. 2. 268.]]

__1 Questioning, asking, inquiring. 
__2 An inquiry into the future.
